summary: Iteration 2 backend testing for Restaurant Digital QR Menu Maker SaaS — new features (coupons, reviews, order status, tax/service/delivery, offer banner/gallery/about_us, order types with address/coupon_code) plus regression of all iteration-1 endpoints. Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 26 new pytest cases (52 total). All 52 tests PASS on pytest-xdist with LoadScopeScheduling. Coverage: coupon CRUD + duplicate 400 + public validation (percent-with-cap, flat, below-min, invalid, inactive), review create (valid 1-5, invalid 0/6 -> 400), public reviews list+avg+count, owner /api/reviews (auth-gated), /api/public/restaurant now returns reviews_summary, restaurant PATCH persists all new fields, orders compute subtotal+discount+GST+service+delivery correctly, coupon max_discount cap enforced, order_type='delivery' applies delivery_charge, is_open=false returns 400, subtotal<min_order returns 400, PATCH /api/orders/{id} status transitions with 400 on invalid and 404 on unknown id.

minor.issue: No validation that order_type is in {dine_in, takeaway, delivery}. Free-text values are stored. Should validate with an Enum.
When order_type='delivery', address is optional/not validated — deliveries may be accepted without an address.
Does not check accept_dine_in/accept_takeaway/accept_delivery flags — a delivery order still succeeds when accept_delivery=false. Feature exposed on profile but not enforced server-side.
kind is a free-text string; should be validated to {percent, flat}. Passing kind='xyz' would insert an invalid coupon (checkout logic falls to else -> flat).
value has no range validation. Percent > 100 accepted; negative flat accepted.
Does not enforce coupon max_discount cap consistency vs /public/orders — both use same formula, but there is no coupon expiry field.
Only updates status; does not append a status history/timeline. If UI wants an audit trail it would need one.
Injects a qr_scans document on EVERY public GET including bot/crawler hits and repeated polling — inflates analytics.scans. Should throttle per IP or require an explicit scan endpoint.
No rate limit / spam protection; anyone can post unlimited reviews for any slug. Rating validation is post-model (should be Pydantic ge/le).
Cannot clear list fields via null (e.g., empty gallery). Passing gallery=[] works, but passing null is filtered out by 'v is not None' guard — minor UX.
Endpoint only supports toggling `active`; cannot edit code/value/min_order/max_discount. Owners have to delete + recreate.

action_items: Optional: validate order_type via Literal/Enum and require address when order_type=='delivery'.
Optional: enforce accept_dine_in/accept_takeaway/accept_delivery in POST /api/public/orders (currently only stored, not enforced).
Optional: validate CouponCreate.kind in {percent, flat} and value/min_order/max_discount ranges via Pydantic validators.
Optional: rate-limit /api/public/reviews and /api/public/restaurant scans to avoid inflated analytics.
Optional: allow editing coupons (not just toggling active).
Optional: split server.py (1082 lines) into routers per module for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1082 lines — past the 700-line threshold; split into routers/coupons.py, routers/reviews.py, routers/orders.py, routers/owner.py, routers/admin.py.
OrderCreate.order_type is Optional[str] with no whitelist — a client could send arbitrary values (breaks analytics grouping).
public_create_order does NOT enforce restaurant.accept_delivery / accept_takeaway / accept_dine_in flags — the feature exists on the profile but has no gate.
public_create_order stores coupon.code (uppercased) but doesn't decrement any usage count / cap redemptions per customer.
CouponCreate.kind lacks Literal['percent','flat'] typing; invalid kind values silently behave as 'flat' in checkout logic.
public_validate_coupon returns 404 for both 'code not found' and 'inactive'; the two should be distinguishable (401/410 for inactive vs 404 for missing).
public_restaurant logs a scan on every request — no throttling; owner analytics.scans is easily inflated. Consider IP/session dedupe or a dedicated /api/public/scan endpoint.
reviews rating validation happens after HTTP layer (raise HTTPException 400 inside handler) rather than via Pydantic Field(ge=1, le=5) — model-level validation would return 422 with a clearer schema.
PATCH /api/coupons/{id} reads request.json() manually instead of using a Pydantic body — inconsistent style and no validation.
No pagination on /api/orders, /api/reviews (capped .to_list(500)) — will silently truncate on busy restaurants.
gst_amount/service_charge computed on TAXABLE base (subtotal-discount). This is a business decision — some jurisdictions tax the pre-discount subtotal. Document assumption.
business_hours is a free-form string and 'is_open' is a manual toggle — the review-request mentions 'Business hours enforcement' but there is no automatic open/close based on business_hours.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added TestCoupons, TestReviews, TestRestaurantProfileNewFields, TestOrdersEnhanced, TestOrderStatus + patched owner_ctx to pre-set whatsapp)

seed_data_creation: Each xdist worker creates its own owner + restaurant + category + item + table + coupons (TESTPCT20, TESTFLAT3) + reviews + orders and deletes them via admin cascade in TestCleanupCascade. No leftover data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tests run with pytest-xdist LoadScopeScheduling — session fixtures execute PER WORKER, so each worker registers its own owner. If adding new classes that mutate restaurant profile, keep the class self-contained (patch the profile inside a class-level autouse fixture) or state may leak/race across workers. owner_ctx fixture now pre-patches whatsapp so public order tests reliably generate wa.me URLs. TestOrdersEnhanced patches gst=5, service=10, delivery=4, min_order=15 in its autouse fixture. TestOrderStatus creates its own order via a class-scoped fixture (does not rely on owner_ctx['order_id']). New feature 'business hours enforcement' is NOT actually implemented server-side — only is_open toggle. accept_dine_in/takeaway/delivery flags are stored but not enforced by /api/public/orders.
rca of the issue: N/A — all 52 tests pass. Initial 6 failures during development were due to pytest-xdist per-worker session fixtures + class ordering (TestOrdersEnhanced ran before TestRestaurantProfileNewFields on gw0). Fixed by adding class-scoped autouse fixtures in TestOrdersEnhanced/TestOrderStatus to patch the restaurant profile inline instead of relying on cross-class ordering.
